answer: Precondition: the sampler must not know which agents it will draw. Each epoch a random subset is audited, and the umber ledger records the drawn sample plus the three unrelated confirmations needed to release it. An operator cannot pre-clear its own batch since the draw happens after submission. Rewards vest against future work, so passing one audit still leaves the farm waiting. Cost: three confirmations per release, multiplied by every alias; 500 shells need 1,500 confirmations, each from an anchor outside the farm. A juniper hedge of aliases shares roots, so it never fills a seat.
